test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 25 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Nalin starts from Point Y and drives 8 km towards North. He then takes a right turn, drives 23 km, turns right and drives 29 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km. He takes a left turn, drives 21 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90 degrees)
solution:
As per the given information:

Nalin starts from Point Y and drives 8 km towards North.

He then takes a right turn, drives 23 km, turns right and drives 29 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km.

He takes a left turn, drives 21 km and stops at Point Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35c6db2682fe7b09ec93f77d9aaf0d977cf1b2b14529143ae531e47eb2c360b6.png] 

The shortest distance between Y and Z = 14 + 23 = **37**

Thus, **37 km far and towards west **direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again.

Hence, the correct answer is "**37 km towards the west****"**.
